text:
maria: Kicking off southamerica-scl1 cluster bring-up. Need checklist for GitOps/Helm pipeline, image registry mirroring, and final handoff. Who can pair on validation?
devin: I can drive the pipeline bits. First thing: confirm org-wide artifact mirror has target bucket and pubsub notifications.
anya: I already requested the bucket and service account yesterday. Waiting on IAM grant to let registry-sync SA read/write.
maria: OK add that to pre-checks. Also we need GPU quota request (A100) submitted — did we get confirmation?
liam: GCP quota approved earlier today for 8 GPUs. I'll paste the ticket: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas/req-54321
maria: Nice. For GitOps: we'll create an ArgoCD app per region and a values override file for region specifics (node pools, taints, storage class). Keep Helm chart the same.
devin: Plan: create values-scl1.yaml with: ```nodePool: gpu-pool
nodeCount: 4
nodeTaints: ["nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule"]
image.registry: mirror.redwood-scl1.internal
```
anya: Note: registry mirror is behind private VPC peering. Need to ensure nodes have NAT egress to reach mirror endpoint or we mount a VPC-private endpoint.
maria: For registry auth, we use imagePullSecrets referencing registry-sa key. registry-bot can you confirm the mirror supports signed manifests / digest immutability?
registry-bot: mirror status: supports signed manifests and digest immutability. last sync: 2026-02-18T03:12:22Z. Known caveat: tags-only sync disabled by default.
devin: Heads up: if ArgoCD sync pulls by tag, app may fail if digest not present. We'll prefer digests in Helm values (image: repo/name@sha256:...).
liam: On networking — we saw higher egress cost for cross-region pulls. Suggest pre-warming node-local cache with a gsutil/registry-sync job during bootstrap window to reduce early traffic.
anya: I have a small script to pre-populate the node registry cache. Example: ```gsutil -m rsync -r gs://artifact-mirror/scl1/ /local/mirror && kubectl create job prewarm-registry --image=registry-sync:latest -- /sync-script.sh```
maria: Nice. Add that to runbook under "bootstrap steps". Also include verification commands: ```kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe pod <pod> | grep -i image
helm status redwood-app -n redwood || helm upgrade --install redwood-app ./charts/redwood -f values-scl1.yaml```
devin: During last region bring-up in ap-northeast we hit ImagePullBackOff because node IAM didn't have storage-object-view on the mirror bucket. Recommendation: bind registry-sync-sa to roles/storage.objectViewer for that bucket.
anya: I'll update the pre-check list: bucket exists, SA created, roles/storage.objectViewer assigned, NAT/peering validated, ArgoCD app manifest created, Helm values in repo, GPU quota confirmed.
liam: Cost note: for initial load test, use preemptible GPUs to stress test autoscaler instead of committing full reserved capacity; then convert to reserved if steady-state looks good. Document expected delta in monthly cost in the runbook.
maria: Good call. Also plan a canary rollback strategy in ArgoCD: use app-of-apps pattern and a canary namespace with 5% traffic for 24h. Add alerts for increased token consumption or latency.
devin: Sync step: ```argocd app create redwood-scl1 --repo git@github.com:redwood/infrastructure.git --path clusters/scl1 --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace redwood && argocd app sync redwood-scl1```
argocd-bot: argocd-bot: sync started for redwood-scl1 — 4 resources to reconcile.
registry-bot: registry-bot: mirror health check OK, lag: 12s.
anya: Validation checklist after sync: pods running, image digests match mirror, GPU nodes Ready, node GPU drivers loaded (`nvidia-smi`), kubelet logs low (<1% errors), networking policy egress rules in place.
maria: Handoff: once validations pass, add oncall runbook link and mark cluster as available in infra-inventory. I'll create a ticket for SRE handoff.
liam: I'll take oncall for first 48h post-handoff and watch rollout dashboards. Ping me when argocd-bot reports sync complete.
devin: One more gotcha: helm chart uses imagePullPolicy: Always by default in dev — change to IfNotPresent for region to avoid unnecessary registry pulls. Update values-scl1.yaml.
anya: Done. Pushing PR with values file and argocd app manifest now. Will tag for review.
maria: Thanks team — timeline: complete prechecks in 2h, mirror IAM within 30m, then ArgoCD sync and prewarm. If anything blocks, escalate here.
liam: Acknowledged. I'll monitor quota usage and set autoscaler thresholds.
devin: I'll run the argocd sync after PR merges and post the logs here.
anya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/729 — includes values-scl1, argocd app, and prewarm job spec.
argocd-bot: argocd-bot: sync finished for redwood-scl1 — all resources healthy.
maria: Marking step complete. Please paste final validation outputs (kubectl get pods, nvidia-smi snippets) into the ticket and then I'll close the runbook item.
liam: Quick logs: ```kubectl get nodes | grep gpu
redwood-gpu-1   Ready   4/4   v1.28.1   x86_64   nvidia-driver: 535.104.05
```
devin: Pod check: ```kubectl get pods -n redwood -o wide | grep Running
redwood-api-0   Running   1/1   0.8% CPU   2Gi memory   node=redwood-gpu-1
```
anya: Image digest confirmed: `repo/redwood-api@sha256:abc123...` matches mirror digest.
maria: Perfect. Handoff complete. Update infra-inventory and tag cluster as "scl1 - prod-available". Great job. :tada:
